'''Leo Radom''' {{post-nominals|country=AUS|AC}} (born 13 December 1944) is an Australian [[computational chemistry|computational chemist]]. He is a Emeritus Professor of Chemistry at the [[University of Sydney]]. He attended [[North Sydney Boys High School]]. He has a PhD and a DSc from the [[University of Sydney]] and carried out postdoctoral research under the late Sir [[John Pople]].<ref>[https://www.sydney.edu.au/science/about/our-people/academic-staff/leo-radom.html Radom Group Homepage]</ref> Previously, he was Professor at the Research School of Chemistry at the [[Australian National University]] in [[Canberra]], [[Australia]]. He has published over 460 papers.

He is [[list of Fellows of the Australian Academy of Science|fellow of the Australian Academy of Science]] (1988)<ref>[http://www.science.org.au/academy/fellows/fellow.htm AAS List of members] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070223041545/http://www.science.org.au/academy/fellows/fellow.htm |date=2007-02-23 }}</ref> and  in 2008 was awarded its Craig Medal for contributions of a high order to any branch of chemistry          by active researchers.<ref>[http://www.science.org.au/awards/craig.htm Craig Medal of the Australian Academy of Science] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071222180156/http://www.science.org.au/awards/craig.htm |date=2007-12-22 }}</ref> He is a member of the [[International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science]] (1989).<ref>[https://www.iaqms.org/members/radom.php International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science page on Leo Radom]</ref> Until 2011, he was President of the [[World Association of Theoretical and Computational Chemists]] (WATOC) and organised the WATOC 2008 Conference in Sydney, Australia.<ref>[http://www.watoc2008.com/ WATOC 2008] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080914181105/http://www.watoc2008.com/ |date=2008-09-14 }}</ref><ref>[https://watoc.net/ Watoc Home page]</ref>

==Awards and honours==
In 2001, Radom was awarded the [[Centenary Medal]] "for service to Australian society and science in computational quantum chemistry".<ref name="HonoursCM">{{cite web|url=https://honours.pmc.gov.au/honours/awards/1124794 |title=Professor Leo RADOM - Centenary Medal |publisher=Australian Honours Search Facility |accessdate=2019-06-10}}</ref>  In 2019, Radom was appointed a [[Companion of the Order of Australia]] "for eminent service to science, particularly to computational chemistry, as an academic, author and mentor, and to international scientific bodies".<ref name="HonoursAC">{{cite web|url=https://honours.pmc.gov.au/honours/awards/2004781 |title=Emeritus Professor Leo RADOM - Companion of the Order of Australia |publisher=Australian Honours Search Facility |accessdate=2019-06-10}}</ref>
